sweep the nation: The catchy dance song began to sweep the nation last summer, and soon every student could sing along.
那首朗朗上口的舞曲去年夏天開始席捲全國，很快每個學生都會跟著唱。
sweep the board: Our school choir managed to sweep the board at the music contest, winning every single prize on offer.
我們學校的合唱團在音樂比賽中大獲全勝，拿下了所有的獎項。
sweep under the carpet: The manager wanted to sweep the safety problems under the carpet, but one brave worker told the newspaper.
經理想要掩蓋安全問題，但一名勇敢的員工把事情告訴了報社。
sweep to power: Promising cheaper housing for young people, the new party was able to sweep to power in the election.
新政黨承諾為年輕人提供更便宜的住房，因而在選舉中壓倒性當選上台執政。
sweep aside objections: The mayor decided to sweep aside objections from local residents and build the new highway anyway.
市長決定不顧當地居民的反對，照樣興建新的高速公路。
sweep the floor: After the class party, we had to sweep the floor and pick up all the paper cups and snack bags.
班級派對結束後，我們得掃地，並撿起所有的紙杯和零食袋。
numbers swelled: As news of the free concert spread online, the numbers swelled from a few hundred to over ten thousand.
隨著免費演唱會的消息在網路上傳開，人數從幾百人增加到一萬多人。
swell with pride: Watching her son receive his diploma on stage, the mother began to swell with pride and smile widely.
看著兒子在台上領取畢業證書，那位母親滿心驕傲，笑得合不攏嘴。
swell the ranks: Hundreds of students joined the beach cleanup this year and helped swell the ranks of local volunteers.
今年有數百名學生參加淨灘活動，幫忙壯大了當地志工的隊伍。
the river swelled: After three days of heavy rain, the river swelled and flooded several farms in the low valley.
連續下了三天大雨之後，河水上漲，淹沒了低窪山谷中的好幾座農場。
swell the crowd: Thousands of tourists arrived for the lantern festival, which helped swell the crowd in the old town.
數千名遊客前來參加元宵燈會，使老街的人潮大幅增加。
swing into action: As soon as the fire alarm rang, the trained staff would swing into action and guide everyone outside.
火災警報一響，受過訓練的員工就會迅速行動，引導大家到外面。
swing the vote: Young voters care deeply about housing prices, so their choices could swing the vote in this close election.
年輕選民非常在意房價，因此他們的選擇可能左右這場勢均力敵選舉的選票。
opinions swing: Public opinions swing quickly online; a star who is loved today may be hated by tomorrow morning.
網路上的輿論意見搖擺得很快；今天受人喜愛的明星，明天早上可能就被討厭了。
swing a deal: The young salesman worked hard for months and finally managed to swing a deal with a big Japanese company.
那位年輕業務員努力了好幾個月，終於和一家日本大公司談成交易。
mood swings: Teenagers often have mood swings, feeling happy one minute and upset the next for no clear reason.
青少年常有情緒起伏，前一分鐘很開心，下一分鐘卻莫名其妙地不高興。
get into the swing of: The first week at the new school was hard, but Amy soon began to get into the swing of things.
在新學校的第一週很辛苦，但艾米很快就進入狀況了。
swing by: I'll swing by your house on my way to the station and drop off the notebook you left.
我去車站的路上會順道拜訪你家，把你忘記拿的筆記本送過去。
switch jobs: Feeling bored with his office work, my uncle decided to switch jobs and become a high school teacher.
我叔叔覺得辦公室的工作很無聊，於是決定換工作，去當高中老師。
switch sides: Halfway through the debate, two members of the other team suddenly decided to switch sides and support our idea.
辯論進行到一半時，對方隊伍有兩名成員突然決定改變陣營，支持我們的想法。
switch off: Please remember to switch off the air conditioner and the lights before you leave the classroom.
離開教室之前，請記得關掉冷氣和電燈。
switch to a new system: Our school will switch to a new system next term, so students can check their grades online.
我們學校下學期將改用新系統，讓學生可以上網查詢成績。
switch gears: After talking about grammar for an hour, the teacher decided to switch gears and play an English song.
講了一個小時的文法之後，老師決定轉換方向，播放一首英文歌。
switch on the light: It was so dark in the hallway that I had to switch on the light before walking down the stairs.
走廊太暗了，我得先開燈才能走下樓梯。
a switch in policy: After many complaints from parents, the school announced a switch in policy and allowed students to bring phones.
在許多家長抱怨之後，學校宣布政策轉變，允許學生帶手機。
tackle a problem: The best way to tackle a problem like this is to break it into small steps and solve each one.
處理這類問題最好的方法，是把它拆成小步驟，逐一解決。
tackle crime: The city has hired more police officers and installed cameras on every street to tackle crime downtown.
為了打擊市中心的犯罪，市政府增聘了更多警察，並在每條街上裝設監視器。
tackle the issue head-on: Instead of ignoring the bullying, the principal chose to tackle the issue head-on and met every class.
校長沒有忽視霸凌事件，而是選擇正面處理這個議題，並和每個班級面談。
tackle an opponent: In rugby, players are allowed to tackle an opponent who is carrying the ball and bring him to the ground.
在橄欖球比賽中，球員可以擒抱持球的對手，把他撲倒在地。
tackle poverty: The government plans to tackle poverty by offering free job training and cheaper housing to poor families.
政府計畫藉由提供貧困家庭免費職業訓練和較便宜的住房來對抗貧窮。
tackle the root cause: Giving out free masks helps a little, but we must tackle the root cause of air pollution: factory smoke.
發放免費口罩雖有些幫助，但我們必須處理空氣污染的根本原因：工廠排放的廢氣。
